script_text: Stop! Aquarius, the stars are screaming at you right now. Uranus, your ruling planet of sudden change, forms a tense square to Mercury retrograding through your 6th House of work, sparking miscommunication with colleagues. As an Air sign, this static disrupts your mental flow. In love, if single you attract a curious Gemini type through 7th House banter; taken ones must avoid snapping over small chores. Career-wise, the 2nd House Venus trine to Pluto urges you to renegotiate a stalled payment or side income today. Warning: do NOT sign any contract before Mercury clears shadow on the 22nd. Follow for tomorrow's reading.

title: Aquarius — Don't Ignore This Signal
youtube_description: Your ruling Uranus is squaring retrograde Mercury in the 6th House, and it changes everything about your work and love today. This reading reveals the exact warning you need before July 22. Comment your sign.
